weights.note: squad_value has no historical data; production weights renormalized over market_odds/refined_elo/rolling_form/rest_days

meta.method: replay: every match predicted with a prior-only context and its own season's pre-match Elo snapshot; no future-data leakage
meta.ece_note: ece = football_core.evaluation.multi_class_ece (confidence-vs-accuracy ECE; the production implementation)

tournament_trps.construction: teams ranked by summed test-match points (3/1/0); ensemble strength = Σ(p_win + 0.5·p_draw); soft rank distribution
tournament_trps.note: tournament-level TRPS block (roadmap criterion 1); secondary, not a gate
